applies_when: When visualizing connections between entities like airports.
avoid: Avoid using bars or lines to represent connections.
guidance: Use nodes for airports and edges for connections.
prompt_text: Create an interactive network graph of U.S. airports.
task: Create an interactive visualization showing connections among major U.S. airports in 2008.
title: Interactive Visualization of Connections Among Major U.S. Airports

applies_when: When creating a visualization that shows trends over time for multiple categories.
avoid: Avoid using static bar charts or scatter plots for this type of data.
guidance: Use a line chart with a timeline slider or animation to show changes over time.
prompt_text: Create an animated line chart showing global population growth.
task: Create an animated chart to visualize global population growth over time.
title: Animated Gapminder Chart Pattern
